discovery_notes: Follow-up 12 of B002 (WDW LE 2019). 23 web searches. New WDW keys for shared DL/WDW Pin Trading Night pins: Sleeping Beauty 60th Maleficent and Aurora (Feb 28), Little Mermaid 30th PTN (Nov 7: King Triton, Ariel & Sisters jumbo, framed jumbo, AP statue, BatB and Great Mouse Detective event pins), Up 10th PTN (May 16: Russell & Dug, Kevin, Up House jumbo, Lady and the Tramp PTN; Ariel PTN held). Shared Fall 2019 Eeyore and Lion King 2019 film LR keyed under wdw with variant notes to dlr keys. No holds released.
